Dear Tailspin Team,

Your refund of **120** for the failed migration fee has been **approved and processed**. It will appear in your account within **3–5 business days**.

**We have also updated your data residency region to sa-central-PO80**, as reflected in your contract system. This change is now active in our records.

**Next Steps:**
- Verify your data region in your account dashboard (should reflect **sa-central-PO80**).
- Reply to this email if the region is incorrect or if you encounter any issues.

This resolves your ticket (C-4916). Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
